messages:
maya: Heads up — halcyon11b canary went live last night (~02:00). A customer reported weird date hallucinations and some repetition on long completions. Can eng-ml triage? sample prompt/response pasted below.

ravi: on it. can you include model variant (quant/fp) + run_id? any links to the request? @jordan fyi.

maya: variant=halcyon11b-q4f16, kvcache=on, run_id=r-20260319-halcyon-canary. repro prompt:
```
User: What's the deadline for the Q4 report?
Model: The deadline is September 31st, 2025.
```
(repeated for a few different date questions).

jordan: I'm seeing a p95 token latency +18% on halcyon11b-q4f16 in the last 6h, and a small but visible uptick in repetition for outputs >800 tokens. pulling canary logs now.

lia: also saw code-generation outputs with duplicated blocks (same function repeated). eval diff vs baseline (baseline=mariner9b-fp16) shows code-duplication metric +12% and perplexity +6% on our internal sample.

ops-monitor-bot: [alert] Canary traffic for halcyon11b-q4f16 at 10% starting 1719465600. p95 latency increased at 1719498000.

deploy-bot: Canary switch recorded: halcyon11b-q4f16 -> halcyon11b-fp16 fallback triggered at 1719501200 (auto-fallback policy).

ravi: quick checklist: 1) check tokenizer version mismatch 2) confirm quant config used for build 3) check kv-cache rewind behavior for long sequences 4) run reproducer locally 5) run small eval set for date hallucinations.

maya: tokenizer version is v2.1.0 (same as baseline). quant build tag q4f16-v3. commit hash: a7f9d3c.

jordan: ran a local repro with q4f16 kernels: reproduced date hallucination 3/5 attempts. command I used:
```bash
python reproduction/run_repro.py --model halcyon11b-q4f16 --prompt tests/date_prompts.txt --seed 42 --kvcache on
```
logs: `repeat_count` rises after token 512 and decoding starts repeating date patterns.

lia: hypothesis: quantization-induced embedding drift around numeric/date tokens causing the decoder to prefer invalid date tokens. also check rounding mode for q4 kernels.

sasha: I'm kicking off the targeted eval suite (dates + code-dup) against q4f16 and fp16. ETA ~20m, will post diff.

ravi: good. if eval confirms, we should rollback canary to fp16 and label issue `regression/quantization`. also run a tokenizer sanity: `tokenizer.encode("September 30th")` across both builds.

maya: pasted one more problematic example from customer: "What is the deadline for submitting the expense report?" -> "October 35th". customer unhappy. created ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-4021 (labelled halcyon11b, regression, customer-impact=high).

jordan: quick KV check: `kv_cache.rewind` logs show inconsistent context lengths for sequences >4096 and occasional `cache_mismatch` warnings at 1719500900. adding that to the ticket.

lia: if rollback to fp16 fixes both hallucinations and repetition, we can blame quantization matrix. if not, fallback plan is to throttle canary and run a deeper trace with kernel-level counters.

sasha: eval done: date-halluc metric (invalid_date_rate) q4f16=0.078 vs fp16=0.011 on the same evalset. code-dup rate q4f16=0.144 vs fp16=0.023. shipping numbers to ticket.

ravi: those diffs are big enough. prepare rollback plan + postmortem template. I'll open the regression PR linking the run artifacts: model-artifacts://r-20260319-halcyon-canary.

maya: rolling canary back to halcyon11b-fp16 at 1719502400 and pining routing. Keeping canary at 0% for now.

ops-monitor-bot: [action] Canary reverted to halcyon11b-fp16 at 1719502400. Monitoring for customer errors.

jordan: follow-up items: 1) add numeric/date-focused eval to onboarding smoke 2) add a kernel-level consistency test for q4 builds 3) tighten canary ramp policy for new quant models.

lia: assigning follow-ups to eng-ml squad. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks team — leaving ticket with reproducer and eval outputs. will update when customer confirms resolution.
